hero.description: I create modern, accessible web interfaces focused on user experience, combining frontend development and UI design.

about.bio1: I’ve been working for 4 years as a frontend developer, passionate about creating beautiful and functional interfaces. With experience in React, Vue.js, JavaScript, and other technologies, I turn ideas into digital reality.
about.bio2: I’m currently studying Systems Analysis and Development and I also focus on UI Design, which I complement with independent studies. This combination of code and design helps me turn ideas into clear, responsive, and well-structured digital experiences. My goal is to continuously grow—deepening my knowledge in both code and design—to build solutions that strengthen the digital presence of brands and businesses.

leanLearn.description: LMS Platform (Learning Management System). It allows companies and educational institutions to create, manage, distribute, and monitor online courses and training programs. This digital platform organizes educational content, facilitates student access, enables assessments, issues certificates, and tracks users’ progress and performance.

teya.description: Website for Teya, a platform that emphasizes a culture of continuous learning, connecting people, ideas, content, and tools to co-create innovative solutions for individuals and companies.

vinx.description: Brazilian real estate development and construction company focused on residential projects and urban development. The company works with real estate incorporation, construction, engineering services, and housing projects in São Paulo, aiming to create modern and accessible living spaces.
